title: Garage Taco Bar
venue_description:
Garage Taco Bar

Garage Taco Bar is a street-food-inspired taco bar in the heart of downtown Binghamton, built around a creative, inclusive menu with vegan and vegetarian options, tequila cocktails and a fun, unpretentious atmosphere.

Atmosphere and Setting

The room has a casual, come-as-you-are energy that suits its role as a newer addition to Binghamton's open mic scene — more taco bar than concert venue, but with enough room and sound for a genuine weekly show.

Open Mic Night

Every Tuesday night, Garage hosts an open mic that started with just a handful of friends and has steadily grown into a real community gathering, drawing poets, singers, rappers and musicians of every type. The night is paired with $3 tacos and $3 tequila shots, keeping things loose and approachable for first-time performers.

Other Programming

Garage also runs Taco Tuesday food specials, an alternating Thursday Quingo Night (a trivia-bingo hybrid), and Friday karaoke, rounding out a busy weekly events calendar.

For Performers

Because the open mic is relatively new and still growing, it's an especially welcoming room for first-time performers looking for a low-pressure crowd.

Good to Know

Garage Taco Bar is located at 211 Washington St, Binghamton, NY 13901, in the heart of downtown.

title: Lost Dog Cafe & Lounge
venue_description:
Lost Dog Café & Lounge

Lost Dog Café & Lounge is a longstanding restaurant, bar and event space on Water Street in downtown Binghamton, built around a genuinely eclectic calendar of dining, dancing, karaoke, trivia and live music.

Atmosphere and Setting

The venue splits its identity between a full-service restaurant and a late-night lounge, giving it the flexibility to host everything from a quiet dinner to a packed jazz jam or drag showcase depending on the night.

Jazz Jam with Miles Ahead

On the first and third Wednesday of every month at 8:00 PM, the Miles Ahead Jazz Quartet leads what Lost Dog calls Binghamton's longest-running jazz night — over 20 years strong. There's no cover charge and no advance sign-up; musicians and vocalists are simply invited to bring an instrument or their voice and sit in with the house band.

Other Programming

Beyond the jazz jam, Lost Dog's calendar includes a Thursday karaoke night with a resident KJ, monthly trivia with a cash prize, and a recurring drag showcase featuring local and regional performers.

For Performers

The jazz jam's 20-plus-year track record and lack of formal sign-up make it one of the most approachable jazz sessions in the region for both seasoned players and musicians new to the style.

Good to Know

Lost Dog Café & Lounge is located at 222 Water St, Binghamton, NY 13901. Because the jazz jam runs on the first and third Wednesday of the month rather than weekly, confirm the date on the venue's event calendar before visiting.

title: WordPlace: The Southern Tier Literary Center
venue_description:
WordPlace: The Southern Tier Literary Center

WordPlace is a literary center on the southwest corner of Binghamton's historic Bundy Campus, affiliated with the Bundy Museum of History & Art and built specifically around spoken word, poetry and prose programming.

Atmosphere and Setting

The space functions as a café and community literary hub, serving food and coffee during the day and adding beer and wine service for evening events. It's a quieter, more focused setting than a typical bar open mic — built for listening as much as performing.

Poetry Open Mic

WordPlace hosts a Poetry Open Mic Thursday led by Bundy Museum Poet-in-Residence J. Barrett Wolf, running from 8:00 PM to 10:00 PM with sign-up starting at 7:45 PM. Each performer gets five to seven minutes and can share up to three pieces of poetry, prose or spoken word.

Other Programming

WordPlace and the adjoining Bundy Museum run a broader slate of literary and cultural events throughout the year, including featured-poet nights and community readings.

For Performers

Because the open mic is scheduled periodically rather than every single week, performers should check the Bundy Museum's calendar or Facebook events page for the next confirmed date.

Good to Know

WordPlace: The Southern Tier Literary Center is located at 26 Cedar St, Binghamton, NY 13905, on the Bundy Campus.
